content:
The test image shows soybean plants with lower canopy leaves turning yellow, covered with small, irregularly shaped dark brown spots/lesions. Some dead tissue has fallen out. This pattern strongly matches the Septoria brown spot reference — yellowing leaves with scattered small dark brown lesions progressing from the lower canopy, with leaves turning yellow beyond the necrotic regions.

SDS shows distinct interveinal patterns (not matching), Bacterial Blight shows angular lesions with halos (not matching), and Downy mildew shows pale green/yellow spots with different morphology.
